newsitem.title: UK: Hello, who's that? It's the prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Hello, who's that? It's the prime minister.

text.p: Julie Brown called her fiance for a chat on Friday, and got through to British Prime Minister John Major.
Brown, 27, called Ashley Reece on his mobile telephone to discuss a weekend party.

But Reece, a contract manager working on Bolton Wanderers Football Club's new stadium, was at that very moment being presented to Major, who was visiting the site during a campaign tour in north-west England ahead of the May 1 election.
Reece, 25, told his bride-to-be that he could not talk as he was with the prime minister, but she refused to believe him.
So Reece passed his phone to Major, who convinced her of his identity and told her to watch that evening's news if she still harboured doubts.
Reece said later: "I'm not quite sure whether she voted Conservative last time. I'm sure she will after this."
